PLENTIS AND KENTUS ARE TWO BEST FRIENDS WHO ARE STILL IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. BOTH HAVE BIG DREAMS TO BECOME FAMOUS SINGERS. THEY LOVE SINGING, COMposing SONGS, AND PERFORMING AT VARIOUS EVENTS. programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: Just For Laughs
programme.desc: Just For Laughs

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Oddbods is an animated, slapstick comedy that embraces adventure and celebrates friendship. Following the wacky adventures of eight unique and furry friends, who laugh, play and get up to mischief in their hometown of Oddsville, where even the most ordinary of situations have unexpected outcomes.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Little Angel is an animated musical show for pre-schoolers. The show has been captivating families around the world with its cheeky humor and catchy upbeat songs.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.title: PINKFONG & FRIENDS
programme.desc: Each episode features a new story that is both entertaining and educational, with interactive moments that invite children to guess, sing, and share in the joy with the characters.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: In a big city where various vehicles happily coexist, the little bus Tayo has just started learning his route around town. There are many things for Tayo to learn. Tayo and his friends, Rogi, Lani, and Gani, help each other to become great grown-up buses.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: SHUKE AND BEITA
programme.desc: Two mice, Shuke and Beta, become partners and embark on amazing adventures. They help other animals with their helicopter and tank, gaining love and friendship along the way.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: It all began with the birth of Rayyanza Malik Ahmad (Cipung), the second son of Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who brought happiness to everyone, even his cousins Zayn and Zuney. However, unlike Rafathar, the eldest child, he felt jealous because he thought all the attention was being taken by Cipung. Then a miracle happened when fairy dust touched Cipung, Rafathar, Zayn, and Zuney. The fairy dust transformed the babies into magical babies and took them to the world of Boba, a place for children where all miracles can happen and without adults knowing. From that moment on, the adventure began. Together with the Boba, the creatures who work there, they created magical tools and encountered various amazing creatures such as tauge monsters, viruses, zombies, snowmen, and even met Supercool, who heightened the adrenaline of their adventure.

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION
programme.desc: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION TELLS THE ADVENTURES OF FIVE SPECIAL TEENS—NAURA, RAHSYA, ADARA, GIBRAN, AND IRSHAD—WHICH ARE FOUND AND CARED FOR BY FATHIR. THESE FIVE CHILDREN HAVE UNIQUE AND DIFFERENT SUPERPOWERS. THEY USE THESE POWERS TO SOLVE VARIOUS CASES AND PROBLEMS THAT OCCUR AROUND THEM. IN ADDITION TO RESCUE MISSIONS, THEY ALSO HAVE TO FACE DAILY CONFLICTS AT SCHOOL, ESPECIALLY FROM THEIR ENEMY GANG, THE BEAST. THIS ANIMATION FOCUS ON THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP, COHESION, AND THE USE OF SUPERPOWERS FOR GOOD.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT'S FAMILY AS THEY STARTED A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! FROM BUILDING BU INAH'S DREAM STORE, THE EXCITEMENT OF BEING NEIGHBORS WITH CEU KOKOM, TO PAK SOMAT'S STRUGGLE TO BECOME AN ONLINE MOTORCYCLE TAXI FOR THE SAKE OF HIS FAMILY. A WARM STORY FULL OF LAUGHTER AND A MORAL MESSAGE SUITABLE FOR ALL AGES.

programme.title: KARTUN FAVORIT KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an engaging show about four young pheasant chicks who grow up in a natural forest under the gentle care and loving guidance of Mother Flora. She always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need her. When the chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (NIU NAITANG DAN PERSAHABATAN YANG INDAH)
programme.desc: SUNNY GIRL NO. 23 IS NOT ONLY ABOUT THE GROWTH JOURNEY OF A CHEESY GIRL, BUT ALSO THE FIRST REALISTIC ANIMATED SERIES THAT REFLECTS PARENT-CHILD EDUCATION AND SCHOOL LIFE IN CHINA. THE MAIN CHARACTER IS AN 8-YEAR-OLD PRIMARY SCHOOL STUDENT.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 26: HORIZONS
programme.desc: Pokémon season 26 horizons follows the new adventures of Ash Ketchum and his friends as they explore new territories they have never explored before. After successfully conquering the Pokémon League in the previous region, Ash decides to seek new challenges and expand the horizons of his adventures. In this new region, Ash meets new Pokémon trainers, including characters eager to test the strength of their teams. While facing various challenges, Ash and his friends also learn about new Pokémon they have never encountered before, as well as the new culture and way of life in the region. However, their adventure is not easy. They must face new threats, including an evil organization that seeks to exploit the power of Pokémon for their own purposes.

programme.title: Northern Borders
programme.desc: Northern Borders' tells the story of ten year-old Austen Kittredge who is sent by his father to live on his grandparents' Vermont farm, where he experiences wild adventures and uncovers long-festering family secrets. It's 1956 and Austen experiences the farm as a place full of eccentric people, especially his stubborn grandparents whose thorny marriage is known as the Forty Years War. Initially feeling stuck in this fractured household, young Austen plans a quick exit but ends up stranded with no choice but to navigate and endure. A humorous and sometimes startling coming-of-age-story, 'Northern Borders' evokes Vermont's wildness, its sublime beauty, a haunted past, and an aura of enchantment.

programme.desc: Frank Castle, known as the Punisher, ruthlessly demolishes organized crime, but it starts an even bigger war.

programme.title: She's Funny That Way (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: On the set of a playwright's new project, a love triangle forms between his wife, her ex-lover and the call-girl-turned-actress cast in the production.

programme.title: 28 Days Later (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Four weeks after a mysterious, incurable virus spreads throughout the United Kingdom, a handful of survivors try to find sanctuary.

programme.title: The International (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: An Interpol agent and a U.S. prosecutor join forces to shut down a bank's funding of terrorism.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: An American woman enters Japan's legendary Suicide Forest in search for her twin sister, who has mysteriously disappeared.

programme.title: The Fourth State
programme.desc: A German journalist investigating the Russian secret service gets caught up in a terrorist plot in Moscow.

programme.title: Death In Texas
programme.desc: Just out of prison, Billy Walker returns to El Paso to find his mom dying of liver failure but low on the transplant list. However, the border offers other, darker options.

programme.title: Hacker
programme.desc: With the help of his new friends Alex Danyliuk turns to a life of crime and identity theft.

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: In San Francisco, an amiable banker's seemingly perfect life is turned upside down when his deceitful fiancée embarks on an affair with his best friend.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: In the lawless West, a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves called The Cowboys reigns over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate finally catches up with them.

programme.title: The Retaliators
programme.desc: An upstanding pastor uncovers a dark and twisted underworld as he searches for answers surrounding his daughter's brutal murder.

programme.title: Wunderland
programme.desc: Lt. Cappa and his American infantry platoon are ordered to defend a vital road junction against a German offensive in the Battle of the Bulge. Despite difficult winter conditions, they must hold their position to stop the German advance.

programme.title: Darkness Of Man
programme.desc: Interpol operative Russell Hatch witnesses the death of an informant when a seemingly routine raid goes wrong. Years later, he finds himself protecting the informant's son from a group of merciless gangs involved in an all-out turf war.

programme.title: Don't Suck
programme.desc: A veteran comedian's last chance at stardom takes him on the road with a young comic who reveals an unexpected past.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: An unassuming young lawyer leads a fight against the Nazis near the end of World War II.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: A British nurse escapes an attack on her outpost. Hunted by a German-led war party, and with help from local warriors, she embarks on an epic journey to save a neighboring outpost.

programme.title: Riot
programme.desc: Cop Jack Stone robs a Russian mob bank to end in the same prison as the mob boss killing Jack's wife. An inmate helps him as does a reporter. Lots of fights.

programme.title: The Rake
programme.desc: Brother and sister, Ben and Ashley, reunite 20 years after the murder of their parents to face the cause of their parents' death, a supernatural creature known as The Rake.

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: A ragtag unit of misfits known as the War Pigs must go behind enemy lines to exterminate Nazis by any means necessary.

programme.title: Traded
programme.desc: In the 1880s western "Traded", a father must leave his ranch for Dodge City to save his daughter from an old enemy, putting his reputation as the fastest draw in the west to the test.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: On the death of his father, Tim Webber returns to his childhood village in Somerset to find something sinister is disturbing the idyllic peace of the villagers.

programme.title: The Junkyard Dogs
programme.desc: Follows a dog who is a master escape artist, who must team up with his puppy pals to prevent their block from being robbed.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: A farmer takes in an injured man with a satchel of cash. When a posse comes for the money, he must decide who to trust. Defending a siege, he reveals a gunslinging talent calling his true identity into question.

programme.title: Hunting Games
programme.desc: When a group of ex-military members is hired to retrieve a lost bag of stolen money, their mission becomes more difficult after a lone hunter finds the bag first.

programme.title: Wicked Games
programme.desc: When Harley joins her new boyfriend for a long Halloween weekend at his country estate, they're invaded by a band of masked freaks and forced to play a Wicked Game. To the intruders' unpleasant surprise, Harley's hard-boiled history has endowed her with a bag of tricks which give the game a surprise ending.

programme.title: Operation Seawolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Among The Shadows
programme.desc: A private investigator must unravel the murder of her uncle while keeping the secret that she is a descendant from a line of werewolves.

programme.title: Bad Men Must Bleed

programme.title: Gravy

programme.desc: In Hasami, Nagasaki Prefecture, ceramics are made through a division of labor among local craftspeople. Aoko (Matsui Rena), who grew up there and works as a porcelain painter, enjoys a quiet life until Tatsuki (Ichinose Hayate), a solitary potter, arrives from Finland. When he declares that his pottery needs no painted decoration, Aoko feels he is rejecting not only her work but her entire community. Yet she gradually finds herself drawn to the beauty of his creations.

Melalui cuplikan arsip langka dan wawancara jujur, film ini mengisahkan perjalanan kariernya di industri film, perjuangannya melawan sorotan publik, dan cobaan pribadi serta profesional yang membentuknya sepanjang jalan. programme.title: Second Account S1 E1
programme.desc: Rini discovered the fact that her sister Dewi took her own life. Seeing many irregularities in her sister's death, Rini conducts her own investigation.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E2

programme.title: Second Account S1 E3

programme.title: Second Account S1 E4
programme.desc: After Rini discovers Haryanto's true identity, she does the only thing to get new facts about Dewi.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E5
programme.desc: The mysterious figure holding Dewi's cell phone is finally revealed. Meanwhile, Rini is trapped in Haryanto's apartment.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E6
programme.desc: Rini returned home. However, when she wanted to forget about her investigation for a moment, Rini was again terrorized by MGK6619.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E7
programme.desc: MGK6619 attacked Rini's house to find the whereabouts of Dewi's cellphone. Rini's fear turned to anger.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E8
programme.desc: Rini finally gets a new testimony from Haryanto. Rini and Haryanto rearrange the chronology of events until they conclude to come to the place where Dewi died.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E9
programme.desc: Rini and Haryanto work together to find new facts directly at the location where Dewi was found dead. The whole town seems reluctant to open the mysterious veil, except for one person.

programme.title: Second Account S1 E10
programme.desc: The truth begins to unfold. Rini finally manages to uncover everything, including the fact that Dewi is involved with something bigger.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E1
programme.desc: Riko, a teenager from Muara Enim, is cursed to remain celibate until he’s 30. Life is smooth until he moves to Jakarta on a scholarship, where endless temptations drive him to despair. With his friend Frans, Riko seeks answers and a way to break free.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E2
programme.desc: On his first day of school, Riko nearly dies but finds an unlikely friend in Frans, who helps him explore his illness—and introduces him to the world of pornography. Meanwhile, Sabrina dives into dating apps, and Desi faces her boss's advances at her new job.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E3
programme.desc: Riko shines in the first half of his futsal game, but things spiral when he’s distracted by cheerleaders in revealing outfits, leading to him puking on Ilham. Realizing he’s not better, he and Frans seek help. Meanwhile, Sabrina’s dating app matches fail, sparking interest in Mahesa, a barista at her favorite café.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E4
programme.desc: After struggling to be honest in the sharing house, Riko turns to a psychologist. He loves the sessions but faces financial hurdles. Meanwhile, Desi wrestles with Bram’s offer to be his second wife, and Sabrina grows closer to Mahesa, ignoring warnings about his underage girlfriend.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E5
programme.desc: After Sabrina rejects Riko, Frans sets him up with other women, but none work out. A scam lands Riko washing dishes at a café, where he bonds with Adel. Together, they spark Sabrina's jealousy as she faces Mahesa’s manipulative love bombing. Meanwhile, Desi meets Bram’s wife and gains her blessing to become his second wife, while Frans finally dates Flo.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E6
programme.desc: Riko and Frans drift apart after a big fight. Frans focuses on his new romance with Flo, while Sabrina and the Lust Gang investigate a leaked deepfake video. Riko, sidelined after facing harassment, seeks advice from Sabrina, leading to unexpected confrontations at home.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E7
programme.desc: Riko, hiding at Maman's, gets unconventional help to deal with his issues with masturbation—from strange lubricants to a clinic visit. Meanwhile, Frans faces a dilemma with Flo’s pregnancy, and Desi pressures Bram while searching for Riko. The Lust Gang uncovers deepfake truths to clear their name.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E8
programme.desc: Riko faces school taunts with more confidence. Frans confronts Flo, demanding accountability. Sabrina prepares for the futsal final while investigating a deep-fake, suspecting Ilham. Desi decides to leave her job.
